QuestInfo.name: Nemi's Lunch Box
QuestInfo.1: You met Nemi again. She thinks the #bBlack Ratz#k that live between #b#m221023000# and the 95th floor stole eggs she prepared for her father's lunch. Nemi wants you to get them back.
QuestInfo.2: You collected all the #bLost Eggs#k that Nemi requested. You wonder what sort of delicious lunch she will make for her father with the eggs...

1.0: Hey, you're back! That's it! That's what I was looking for! My father will love it when he sees it in his lunchbox! Thank you so much, yet again. Here, this is an item that I truly cherish, and it's for you. Hope you like it.

yes.0: Do you like the #b#t1032012##k? Now that I have the ingredients ready, I'll have to get back to cooking. I can literally see my dad drooling over this as we speak.

item.0: You still haven't gathered the #b#t4032734#s#k I asked for. Go defeat the #rBlack Ratz#k, who are usually located between #b#m221023000# and the Eos Tower 95th Floor#k, and bring back #b30 #t4032734#s#k.

0.0: Hi. It's sunny here today. I can't tell you how much I love the fact that it's sunny here 365 days a year. How's it going? Are you here just to say hi? Well, if that's so... then can you help me out one more time...?

yes.0: Thank you so much! I wanted to make a healthy lunch for my dad, but the Black Ratz stole all the ingredients I had prepared.
yes.1: Please eliminate the #bBlack Ratz#k and bring me more lost #r#t04032734#s#k. A total of 30 eggs were lost.

no.0: I see... you must be swamped with other things yourself. If you ever find some time, then please come talk to me. I can always use some help, you know.
